configuration.executor: one dedicated caller thread per client
configuration.input_prefix_fingerprint: FNV-1a 64-bit over the first 100 measurement batches per client, including physical canonical key bytes and payload bytes
configuration.measurement_slot_schedule: each client starts a local phase operation index at zero; slot is phase index modulo pool size

final_validation.revision_progression_scope: each acknowledged write advances the same slot revision; final and reopened per-key revisions exactly match the latest acknowledged revision, while untouched slots retain their baseline revision; keys in each acknowledged batch share one revision

latency.sampling: all acknowledged batch completions counted in fixed buckets

process_metrics.sampling_scope: measurement phase including admission and drain; warmup and final validation excluded

reopen_validation.revision_progression_scope: each acknowledged write advances the same slot revision; final and reopened per-key revisions exactly match the latest acknowledged revision, while untouched slots retain their baseline revision; keys in each acknowledged batch share one revision
